audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart gave Singed four of seven rows on a 47.69% Emerald+ win rate (390 games), and it directly contradicted the page's own prose. The prose says level 1 is Singed's free window ('Heimerdinger has no turrets yet'), that level 3 is 'a brick wall', that 'levels 4 through 6 are Heimerdinger's dominance window', and that first item is 'genuinely contested' / 'up for grabs' — but the chart said Heimerdinger/Skill/Singed/Singed/Heimerdinger/Singed/Singed. Content whys[1] and whys[5] both say 'contested'/'up for grabs' while win[5] said Singed.
audit.why: The packet chart (Singed, Skill, Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger, Skill, Singed) matches both the sub-50% win rate and every line of prose already on the page.
audit.corrected: Whole chart realigned to the packet in both layers as one atomic group: Level 1 to Singed, Levels 3 and 4-5 to Heimerdinger, First item to Skill. Phase whys rewritten to match their new sides.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every phase why was generic template text ('Ult-ghost-proxy is a macro weapon', 'Full kit online — your core pattern starts now') that named no Heimerdinger ability and no timing, and UPGRADE!!! was written as 'Upgrade!' and 'Upgrade!!!' with no cooldown.
audit.why: His spikes are the turret nest at 3, the dominance window at 4-6, and UPGRADE!!! at 6 (100/85/70). Yours are the pre-turret level 1 and Rylai's.
audit.corrected: Phase whys now name the turret nest, the flat-11s grenade, UPGRADE!!! at 100s, and the Rylai's inflection.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two concrete errors and one missing interaction. (a) The grenade's cooldown is written as 'around 12 seconds'; CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is a flat 11 seconds at every rank — it never gets shorter as he levels it, which is the whole reason a disciplined proxy loop works. (b) The stun is treated as area-wide. Riot's text: 'stunning anyone directly hit and slowing surrounding units' — clipping the edge only slows you, so the grenade is dodgeable in a way the page never says. (c) Hextech Affinity ('Gain Move Speed while near allied towers and turrets deployed by Heimerdinger') is never mentioned, yet Fling displacing him off his own nest strips that move speed — that is what 'fling him off nest' actually accomplishes.
audit.why: Riot Data Dragon descriptions and cooldowns for both kits.
audit.corrected: Grenade corrected to a flat 11s with the direct-hit-only stun stated; Hextech Affinity written into the Fling advice; UPGRADE!!! given its 100s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'around 12 seconds' for the tracked cooldown, and the tracked cooldown block gave no number at all.
audit.why: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is 11 flat; Hextech Micro-Rockets is 11/10/9/8/7 at 1325 range; UPGRADE!!! is 100/85/70.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into the cooldown block, the do, and the interactions row.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two fabricated details. The turret is called 'H-28G Evolution Turret' in five places; Riot's name is 'H-28 G Evolution Turret'. And the upgraded grenade is described as 'a comet stun across the entire screen' / 'screen-wide' twice — nothing in Riot's text supports a screen-wide range, and the base grenade is 970 units. Rockets are 1325, which is the real long-range threat and was unstated.
audit.why: Riot Data Dragon names and ranges; the packet also flagged 'Evolution Turrets' as a probable wrong name.
audit.corrected: Turret name fixed; the screen-wide claim replaced with UPGRADE!!!'s real cooldown and the rockets' real 1325 range.

edits.before: At level 1 you have one real asset: Heimerdinger has no turrets yet. Run straight at him with Poison Trail active the moment the wave meets — you are not trying to kill him, you are contesting the first minions and making him spend his movement to dodge your cloud instead of placing turrets freely. The moment his H-28G Evolution Turrets start stacking behind the wave, your ability to step up safely collapses. Accept that level 2 is a coinflip depending on whether you can bait a CH-2 Grenade before you Fling — if he has it ready, abort every engage. By level 3 his three-turret nest is a brick wall: do not walk into it for any reason, because the electric beam proc plus CH-2 Grenade landing while you are slowed in the cluster will delete half your health bar.

edits.before: Levels 4 through 6 are Heimerdinger's dominance window and you need to accept that cleanly. Your job is proxy farming — get behind his wave between his tower and the river, force him to choose between clearing you or maintaining lane, and deny him the comfortable nest he needs to snowball. Every time you proxy, his turrets are idle and his gold engine stalls. Never try to fight through the turret wall face-on; the CH-2 Grenade cooldown is around 12 seconds and the turret beam resets fast enough that a stunned Singed standing in three beams is a flash-to-tower moment. At level 6 his Upgrade!!! CH-2 Grenade becomes a screen-wide comet stun — respect it like a Caitlyn ult and keep moving laterally whenever he has Upgrade available.

notes: The chart was the big one: four rows disagreed with the page's own prose AND with a 47.69% win rate. Flipped as one atomic group in both layers to the packet chart. Second-biggest: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is a FLAT 11s at all five ranks (the page said 'around 12 seconds'), and it only stuns on a direct hit — the surrounding area just slows. I removed the 'screen-wide comet stun' description of the upgraded grenade because nothing in Riot's data supports it; I did not replace it with a specific upgraded range because that range is not in the kit file. No mirror existed (audits/top/heimerdinger__singed.json is absent), so nothing to reconcile. Cooldowns used: Heimerdinger W 11/10/9/8/7 at 1325 range, E 11 flat at 970, R 100/85/70; Singed W 17/16/15/14/13, E 10/9.5/9/8.5/8, R 100.
